## 2026-11-23

### Changes

- Improved the handling of hidden web views to keep timers running in the background when we are running automations on a page.
- Releases now attach zip files of the release artifacts and a checksums file with the list of checksums to use for integrating the artifacts directly into your own SPM Package.swift.
- Fixed a possible crash when an acknowledgement removes a pending packet while Uplink is retransmitting.
- `page.evaluate` can finish when navigation destroys its JavaScript context, and selector/function waits resume polling on the new document within their original timeout.

### Requirements

| Name  | Version |
| ----- | ------- |
| Xcode | >= 26.1 |
| iOS   | >= 15.0 |
